shorts.title: What you will learn: break and continue
shorts.hook: Break stops a loop. Continue only skips one round.
shorts.script: Break stops a loop. Continue only skips one round. Today we take control of loops. Break stops the loop. Continue skips one round. Break leaves the loop at once. The program continues after the loop. Continue skips the rest of this round, and goes to the next round. Both keywords work in while loops and for loops. Think of a school bus. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: break and continue.

shorts.title: break and continue in one minute
shorts.hook: Break leaves the loop at once.
shorts.script: Break leaves the loop at once. The program continues after the loop. Continue skips the rest of this round, and goes to the next round. Both keywords work in while loops and for loops. Think of a school bus. Break means the bus stops for good. Continue means the bus skips one stop. The loop counts from ten to thirty. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: break and continue in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: The loop counts from one to five.
shorts.script: The loop counts from one to five. When i is three, the test is true. Continue skips the rest of this round. The print does not run. For the other numbers, the print runs. The output is one, two, four, five. The program prints one two four five. The number three is missing. Break leaves the loop at once. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: Break instead of continue
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in break and continue?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in break and continue? Bug of the Day. We want to skip the number three. The program prints one and two, and then stops. We used break. Break ends the whole loop. To skip only one round, use continue. Break ends the whole loop, so four and five never print. Continue skips only the round for three. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: Break instead of continue.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: Can you skip the multiples of three in break and continue?
shorts.script: Can you skip the multiples of three in break and continue? Break and continue had an argument. Break left. Continue just kept going. Print the numbers from one to twenty. Skip every multiple of three. Write your answer in the comments. Break leaves the loop at once. Continue skips to the next round. Code after the loop still runs after a break. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Pun and challenge.
